Fix to my earlier note on Sphere Gardens: banks must land on public ground, never a plot. North bank: the Sphere Gardens park, if it reaches Circus Road's north edge (its extent was not shown). Both banks meet the platform edge by a concourse bridge (at least 4.5 m), since carriageway lies under the platforms.

Sphere Gardens south bank is not settled. Circus Road is 18 m with a 6 m median: the median is under the 8 m a bank needs, and about 6 m a side cannot hold a 7 m stair tower plus kerb and walk. The only ground wide enough is the two forecourt plots (y -33 to -9). Handed to Datum.

Source conflict, not resolved by me: levels.station says banks never land on a plot; stationEntrance.siting lets a bank take 'a station forecourt (an open plot kept for it)'. The south bank at Sphere Gardens turns on which one the checker reads.
S-S2 spacing along the trunk: gardens to circus 255 m, circus to harbour 245 m, harbour to skyport 205 m, all inside 200-500. Skyport cannot move west without squeezing the 205.

Crown Circus banks stand in the drum's ground hall on the Parade mall, towers and lifts 7.75-14.75 m off the line, between the 4 m hall lane and the legs at y ±20. Harbour banks land on the causeway quay (y ±25), Skyport banks on the apron quay (y ±40) between the tower legs.

Parade-gate is a running portal (half-width 6; a station needs 16), so no third in-building station. Tram stops were not shown, so I did not judge N-R1 reach or the T2/harbour interchange (150 m limit); no sky station moved.
